judge_panel.matching_evidence:
[mathematical] **Incorrect target set in the connectivity constraint.**
   In Section III.C, Equation (9) bounds $y_i \le \sum_{j \in V} \mathbb{I}\{\text{path exists from } i \text{ to } j\}$. Here, the sum is over the entire node set $V$, which includes both CAVs and RSUs ($V = V_{CAV} \cup V_{RSU}$). This means that if a CAV has a valid path to *any* other node (even a disconnected CAV), the sum evaluates to $\ge 1$, allowing $y_i = 1$.
   *Why it matters:* The variable $y_i$ is supposed to indicate whether the CAV is successfully connected to an RSU. Equation (9) fails to enforce this, allowing the solver to maximize the objective by simply creating isolated pairs/components of CAVs.
   *Fix:* Change the summation index to sum only over the RSU set: $\sum_{j \in V_{RSU}}$.
judge_panel.reasoning: This exactly identifies the widened summation index set from RSUs to all nodes in the connectivity constraint and prescribes the original RSU-only index.
